title: Chat paper row uses the composer's pills; citations read Han et al., 2018, p. 2
description: User feedback on 2026-10-10: "On chat screen we have papers on top. But this is the previous design and not consistent with our editor pills. Also hovering them shows a show summary modal, which we should remove. Then the Citation pills in chat \"Han 2018 -middle dot- p. 2\" contains middle dot, which is an obvious AI-ism." Decisions taken with the user: (1) the row appears only when a chat covers more than one paper and uses the same PaperPill as the composer; (2) citation chips to a paper in a multi-paper chat read in APA 7 parenthetical form without brackets, "Han et al., 2018, p. 2", and single-paper chats keep "p. 2"; (3) clicking a pill in the row opens that paper's PDF in a reader tab, as a citation to it does. The summary popup is removed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chat with one paper, when it shows, then there is no paper row above the thread.

Given a chat with two or more papers, when it shows, then a row above the thread shows each paper with the composer's PaperPill: file icon and title, darker on hover or focus with a corner × when the paper can be removed, and a hover card with the short citation. Beyond three pills a '+N' pill opens a list of the rest as the same pills. Server rules on removal are unchanged (the last paper can't be removed).

Given a pill in that row, when it is clicked or activated with Enter, then that paper's PDF opens in a reader tab, as a citation to it does. Without a workspace reader it opens the paper's page. There is no summary dialog and no 'Show summary' tooltip.

Given a citation to a paper in a multi-paper chat, when its chip shows, then it reads APA-style 'Han et al., 2018, p. 2' (one author 'Han, 2018'; two authors 'Han & Shin, 2018'; no year 'n.d.'; no authors falls back to a short title), with no middle dot, and its accessible name matches. In a single-paper chat the chip stays 'p. 2'.
Given the codebase, when this lands, then PaperSummaryDialog and anything only it used are deleted, and README's citation example is updated.

Given a pill in the paper row, when it is hovered or focused, then its corner × is named 'Remove <title> from this chat' (composer pills keep 'Remove <title>'), because it removes the paper from the whole chat rather than a mention from the question. Added after the user's approval: "OK, add those to ARA-110".

Given a paper is removed from the chat through its pill, when the removal succeeds, then a toast 'Removed from this chat' offers Undo, and focus moves to the next pill (the previous one, else the pane) so keyboard users are not stranded.

Given Undo is pressed, when the paper is added back with POST /chats/{id}/papers, then its pill returns; if the re-add fails, then an error toast in plain words says the paper could not be put back in this chat. Known limit: Undo restores the paper's current PDF, not an older pinned version that its removal deleted.
test_cases: Row hidden for one paper; shown with PaperPill for several; +N overflow list.
Pill click opens the paper's reader tab (workspace) or navigates (no workspace); no summary dialog.
Citation label formats for one, two and three+ authors, missing year, missing authors; no '·'.
verification: Red then green with vitest: new tests for apaAuthorDate/sourceLabel/PaperPill/row/overflow/pill click/no dialog/remove label/toast/Undo/focus failed first, then passed. Final npm run check and npm run build results in docs/agent-development-log.md. Screenshots by Playwright against a Vite dev server with route-mocked API in the session scratchpad (ara110/).
